segments.name: Natural gas
segments.description: Exploration and appraisal stage natural gas company developing unconventional gas resources in Australia's Northern Territory.
segments.evidence: The Group is in the exploration and appraisal stage with a current focus on exploiting its primary assets, which are rights to working interests ("Tenements") in exploration acreage in the Beetaloo sub-basin ("Beetaloo" or "Beetaloo Basin"), NT Australia.
